title: The Macachor Scalar Theorem: A Generalized Pythagorean Framework for Scalar Field Ontology, Quaternion Coherence, and Quantum Hardware Architecture
description: This work proposes that reality at its substrate level is described entirely by scalar fields, with all vector/tensor/spinor quantities emergent from scalar gradients, curvatures, and density differentials. The Macachor Scalar Theorem generalizes the Pythagorean theorem to n-dimensional orthogonal scalar superposition. A quaternion extension provides norm-preserving quantum coherence protocols. The Macachor Absolute governs equilibrium ratios and quantization boundaries. Two operational architectures are formalized: KIWF and CRHA.
